sinopsis.es: Yeka, de 12 años, ama y admira a su hermano, un cantante emergente de reguetón que le promete a ella y a su familia sacarlos del contexto precario en el que viven.
sinopsis.en: Twelve-year-old Yeka loves and admires her brother, an emerging reggaeton singer who promises her and their family a way out of the precarious conditions they live in.
